abstract: The DNA ploidy of testicular seminomas was studied by flow cytometry using paraffin embedded samples. The mitotic count and DNA index (DI) for 27 seminomas were analyzed in 80 samples with a mean of 3.0 samples per case. Six anaplastic seminomas which were with 3 or more mitoses per a high power field were distinguished from 21 typical seminomas. DNA ploidy pattern was aneuploid in all seminomas except one case of anaplastic seminoma, and clonal heterogeneity in DNA content was found in 3 of 20 (15%) cases of which 2 or more samples were analyzed. Although the DI had no significant difference between those two groups of seminomas classified by mitotic count, the DI in anaplastic seminomas was ranged from 1.5 to 2.0 (median DI = 1.70), otherwise the DI in typical seminomas ranged from 1.5 to 3.5 (median DI = 1.89), particularly 9 cases in 21 (43%) typical seminomas distributed in hypertetraploid region. The median DI of stage I seminomas was 1.88 and that of stages II + III seminomas was 1.75, though there was also no significant correlation between DI and clinical stages. In general, it is postulated that the higher DI is paralleled to the more malignant nature of neoplasms, nevertheless this study suggested that the higher DI in seminomas is not always related to high malignant potentiality determined by histological type and clinical stage.
abstract_ja: パラフィン包埋標本を用いてフローサイトメトリーにより精巣セミノーマのDNA倍数性を検討した。27例のセミノーマについて、平均3.0検体ずつ計80検体を解析し、核分裂数とDNA indexを評価した。核分裂数3個以上/高倍率視野の未分化型セミノーマ6例と、典型的セミノーマ21例を区別した。未分化型の1例を除くすべてが異数性を示し、2検体以上解析した20例中3例（15%）でDNA含量のクローン性不均一性が認められた。DNA indexは核分裂数による2群間で有意差はなかったが、未分化型セミノーマでは1.5〜2.0（中央値1.70）、典型例では1.5〜3.5（中央値1.89）であった。典型例21例中9例（43%）は過四倍体領域に分布していた。病期I（中央値1.88）とII+III（中央値1.75）の間にも、DNA indexと臨床病期の有意な相関は認められなかった。一般に高いDNA indexは腫瘍の悪性度の高さと並行すると考えられるが、本研究ではセミノーマにおいて高いDNA indexが組織型や臨床病期で定義される高い悪性潜在能力と必ずしも関連しないことが示された。
